High byte of reg 25 (packet[53]). Reports the state of the internal battery heater circuit used to warm cells in sub-zero ambient conditions so that charging is safe (lithium cells must not be charged below 0 °C). 0x80=Heater ON — the BMS has activated the heating element; charging may be deferred or reduced until cell temperatures rise above the charge_ut_protect threshold (reg 91). 0x00=Heater OFF — cells are at or above the minimum charge temperature; heater is not energized. No other values are defined. Monitor in conjunction with temp_sensor_1..4 (regs 33-34) and charge_ut_warn/protect/release (regs 90-92) to understand thermal management behavior.

Reg 27 bit 13. Hard protection: float-charge phase was stopped by the BMS (e.g. timeout or fault during absorption/float). 1=Float_Stopped tripped, 0=clear.

Reg 27 bit 2. Hard protection: pack voltage dropped below the under-voltage protection limit. BMS opens discharge FET to halt load. 1=Pack_UV tripped, 0=clear.

"Low byte of reg 25 (packet[54]). Reports the BMS operating mode and active-state flags as a single byte code. The high bit (0x80) distinguishes Active from Inactive states. Inactive codes (BMS output FETs may be open or limited): 0x00=Inactive/Standby (idle, no charge or discharge), 0x01=Inactive/Charging (charge FET open, accepting charge), 0x02=Inactive/Discharging (discharge FET open, supplying load), 0x04=Inactive/Protect (FETs held open by a protection condition — check regs 26-28), 0x08=Inactive/Charging_Lmt (current-limited charge; BMS throttling input). Active codes (BMS FETs closed, normal operation): 0x80=Active/Standby (FETs closed but no significant current flow), 0x81=Active/Charging (normal charge in progress), 0x82=Active/Discharging (normal discharge in progress), 0x84=Active/Protect (transient protect condition; FETs may momentarily open), 0x88=Active/Charging_Lmt (FETs closed but charge current is being actively limited by BMS). Any value not listed above should be treated as unknown/reserved."
